Standalone compilation will fail if they are not inserted. Scale and line width follow STYLE METRICS (1.5pt, round joins, 16.5/19.8 pt labels). Circle centred at O with radius 3.68 (about 191 px * 0.019512, measured from O to A). A-D-F-C and B-O-D-E are drawn as collinear named chains covering AD, DF, FA, FC, BO, OD, DE and BE. Right angle at F is a single angle pic on rays A and B, side 0.484 cm (24.82 px). A-O is dashed. Note for remeasurement: O is not the midpoint of AH in the supplied coordinates (O is at y=-0.338, the midpoint of A and H would be near y=0.31), so the figure is not a diameter AH; I kept the program coordinates unchanged as instructed.
